items.html: And the matter is that the truth is that the lights do not finish being corrected until the end of the seven months, but they begin to be corrected from a bit into the seventh, until they are completed at the end of the seventh. For in the first month a bit of them was corrected, and then what was corrected entered into the Kelim. And in the second month, more of the phase of the lights were corrected and entered into the Kelim, until, over the entirety of the seven months, all the lights finished being corrected and entering into the Kelim.
